title: glosa problem card
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §2.2 stage S1 (Problem intake, ปัญหา): the two-question intake gate (issue as a retained difference; the human's own proposal, 'none' a legal, never-inferred answer) plus standpoint declaration, before any analysis starts. This is the `intake.schema.json` REPO_SPEC_v0.5.md names as 'S1's problem_card.schema.json, one object, one name' -- filed here under its problem_card name per this task's own naming. Exit gate is a self-check readiness verdict (READY_FOR_S2), not a release gate -- contrast with schema/readiness_report.schema.json, which is the general pre-work project-readiness self-check. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.
$comment: TODO(schema.pre-exposure-anchor-fields): design/SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §9.2 / §3 SA-3 (status: with_revision, NOT built this pass) -- three new required Problem Card `intake` fields (`problem_stated_before_first_ai_response`, `prior_model_or_guess`, `verification_intent`) are pending a citation fix (EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:354 -> :353) and either the timestamp cross-check script the proposal's own acceptance_test requires, or a narrowed schema-required-fields-only acceptance_test; retroactive-vs-forward-only applicability is also a pending founder decision (§7 item 4).

intake.description: The two-question intake gate: Q1 states the issue as a retained difference (not a bare label); Q2 is the human's own proposal or explicitly 'none' -- an AI session may never infer Q2's answer on the human's behalf (§2.2 co-production split).

retained_difference_statement.description: The issue restated as: a difference that survives under a declared agency/context/query -- not merely a name for a topic.

text.description: 'none' is a legal, honest value -- never silently filled in by an AI session on the human's behalf.

precommitted_resistance_route.description: DEPRECATED (MUST fix, ARCH_REVIEW_v0.7.json founder-invariants: one-fact-one-home) -- superseded by `entry_anchor.resistance_route` below, same R* fact, single home going forward. Kept read-only for backward compatibility with already-scaffolded instances (kernel's `_precommit_route_flag` still reads this path if `entry_anchor.resistance_route` is absent); never write both on a fresh instance. Originally: SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §2.1/§2.2 (schema.entry-resistance-precommit-field, build_now), the R* term of ENTRY_H->AI = H_0 ^ V_0 ^ C_0 ^ R* (sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:356).

entry_anchor.description: HU-2 (build_now, merges with schema.entry-resistance-precommit-field's R* conjunct), FOUNDATION_v0.7_PATCH.md §2/§6, methodology/P18_session_architecture.md's Session-object table (`entry_anchor (H0)` row): the H0 conjuncts ENTRY_H->AI = H_0 ^ V_0 ^ C_0 ^ R* (sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v7.1.txt:344 'H_0 = (P_0, M_0, U_0, E_0, Phi_0)', :351, :355, :356). All five sub-fields are optional, human-authored, never silently AI-backfilled (mirrors the existing q2_user_proposal 'none' precedent). `resistance_route` is the single home for the R* fact -- supersedes the deprecated `precommitted_resistance_route` sibling above.

change_condition.description: Phi_0. 'none stated -- exploratory' is a legal, explicit honest-optional value, never silently inferred.

resistance_route.description: R* -- a concrete route (source/record/experiment/critic/authority) precommitted before the first AI-turn line in the linked Blackbox Note. Single home for this fact (one-fact-one-home) -- supersedes `intake.precommitted_resistance_route` above. Null/absent triggers the D-NO-PRECOMMIT-ROUTE flag (kernel-only, never a hard block) once readiness.verdict reaches READY_FOR_S2.

readiness.description: Self-check verdict only -- explicitly NOT a release gate (§2.2 S1 exit-gate column).

allOf.description: READY_FOR_S2 requires the reason for readiness to actually be stated (an honest self-check names why, not just a bare verdict).
